keyPoints.en: Water makes up about 70% of a cell. It is a polar molecule that forms hydrogen bonds.
keyPoints.bm: Air membentuk kira-kira 70% sel. Ia molekul berkutub yang membentuk ikatan hidrogen.

keyPoints.en: Universal solvent: dissolves many substances, so it is the medium for reactions and transport (blood, sap).
keyPoints.bm: Pelarut universal: melarutkan banyak bahan, jadi menjadi medium tindak balas dan pengangkutan (darah, sap).

keyPoints.en: High specific heat capacity keeps body temperature stable; high latent heat of vaporisation cools us when sweating.
keyPoints.bm: Muatan haba tentu tinggi menstabilkan suhu badan; haba pendam pengewapan tinggi menyejukkan kita semasa berpeluh.

keyPoints.en: Cohesion and adhesion help water move up xylem; water is a lubricant (synovial fluid, tears) and a reactant in photosynthesis and hydrolysis.
keyPoints.bm: Daya lekitan dan lekatan membantu air naik melalui xilem; air ialah pelincir (bendalir sinovia, air mata) dan bahan tindak balas dalam fotosintesis dan hidrolisis.

question.en: Why can pond organisms survive cold nights?
question.bm: Mengapa organisma kolam dapat hidup pada malam yang sejuk?

answer.en: Water's high specific heat capacity means the pond's temperature changes slowly.
answer.bm: Muatan haba tentu air yang tinggi menyebabkan suhu kolam berubah perlahan.

tip.en: Link each property of water to one function in organisms.
tip.bm: Kaitkan setiap sifat air dengan satu fungsi dalam organisma.

keyPoints.en: Carbohydrates contain C, H and O (ratio H : O = 2 : 1).
keyPoints.bm: Karbohidrat mengandungi C, H dan O (nisbah H : O = 2 : 1).

keyPoints.en: Monosaccharides (glucose, fructose, galactose) → disaccharides (maltose, sucrose, lactose) → polysaccharides (starch, glycogen, cellulose).
keyPoints.bm: Monosakarida (glukosa, fruktosa, galaktosa) → disakarida (maltosa, sukrosa, laktosa) → polisakarida (kanji, glikogen, selulosa).

keyPoints.en: Condensation joins sugars (releases water); hydrolysis breaks them (needs water, enzymes or acid).
keyPoints.bm: Kondensasi menyambung gula (membebaskan air); hidrolisis memecahkannya (perlu air, enzim atau asid).

keyPoints.en: Tests: Benedict's (reducing sugars → brick-red), iodine (starch → blue-black). Sucrose: hydrolyse with HCl, neutralise, then Benedict's.
keyPoints.bm: Ujian: Benedict (gula penurun → merah bata), iodin (kanji → biru tua). Sukrosa: hidrolisis dengan HCl, neutralkan, kemudian Benedict.

keyPoints.en: Functions: energy source (glucose), energy store (starch, glycogen), structure (cellulose).
keyPoints.bm: Fungsi: sumber tenaga (glukosa), simpanan tenaga (kanji, glikogen), struktur (selulosa).

question.en: Why must the sucrose test be neutralised before adding Benedict's solution?
question.bm: Mengapa ujian sukrosa mesti dineutralkan sebelum menambah larutan Benedict?

answer.en: Benedict's solution only works in alkaline/neutral conditions; acid would stop it reacting.
answer.bm: Larutan Benedict hanya berfungsi dalam keadaan alkali/neutral; asid akan menghalang tindak balas.

tip.en: Sucrose is the only common sugar here that is NON-reducing.
tip.bm: Sukrosa satu-satunya gula biasa di sini yang BUKAN gula penurun.

keyPoints.en: Proteins contain C, H, O, N and sometimes S. Units: about 20 types of amino acids.
keyPoints.bm: Protein mengandungi C, H, O, N dan kadangkala S. Unit: kira-kira 20 jenis asid amino.

keyPoints.en: Amino acids join by peptide bonds (condensation) → dipeptide → polypeptide.
keyPoints.bm: Asid amino bergabung melalui ikatan peptida (kondensasi) → dipeptida → polipeptida.

keyPoints.en: Protein structure levels: primary (sequence), secondary (helix/sheet), tertiary (3-D folding), quaternary (several chains, e.g. haemoglobin).
keyPoints.bm: Aras struktur protein: primer (jujukan), sekunder (heliks/helaian), tertier (lipatan 3-D), kuaterner (beberapa rantai, cth. hemoglobin).

keyPoints.en: Essential amino acids must come from food; non-essential ones can be made by the body.
keyPoints.bm: Asid amino perlu mesti diperoleh daripada makanan; yang tidak perlu boleh disintesis badan.

keyPoints.en: Functions: enzymes, hormones (insulin), antibodies, structure (keratin, collagen), transport (haemoglobin). Test: biuret → purple.
keyPoints.bm: Fungsi: enzim, hormon (insulin), antibodi, struktur (keratin, kolagen), pengangkutan (hemoglobin). Ujian: biuret → ungu.

question.en: Why does a fever above 42 °C become dangerous?

answer.en: High heat breaks bonds in proteins (enzymes), changing their 3-D shape — they denature and stop working.
answer.bm: Haba tinggi memutuskan ikatan dalam protein (enzim), mengubah bentuk 3-D — ia ternyahasli dan berhenti berfungsi.

tip.en: Protein shape = protein function. Change the shape and it stops working.
tip.bm: Bentuk protein = fungsi protein. Ubah bentuk dan ia berhenti berfungsi.

keyPoints.en: Lipids contain C, H, O but much less oxygen than carbohydrates. They are insoluble in water but soluble in organic solvents.
keyPoints.bm: Lipid mengandungi C, H, O tetapi oksigen jauh lebih sedikit daripada karbohidrat. Tidak larut dalam air tetapi larut dalam pelarut organik.

keyPoints.en: Fats/oils (triglycerides) = 1 glycerol + 3 fatty acids joined by ester bonds.
keyPoints.bm: Lemak/minyak (trigliserida) = 1 gliserol + 3 asid lemak disambung oleh ikatan ester.

keyPoints.en: Saturated fats (animal fat, butter) are solid; unsaturated (palm oil, olive oil) are liquid. Too much saturated fat raises cholesterol.
keyPoints.bm: Lemak tepu (lemak haiwan, mentega) pepejal; tak tepu (minyak sawit, minyak zaitun) cecair. Lemak tepu berlebihan meningkatkan kolesterol.

keyPoints.en: Other lipids: phospholipids (membranes), steroids (cholesterol, hormones), waxes (waterproof leaf cuticle).
keyPoints.bm: Lipid lain: fosfolipid (membran), steroid (kolesterol, hormon), lilin (kutikel daun kalis air).

keyPoints.en: Functions: energy store (twice the energy of carbohydrates per gram), insulation, protecting organs. Test: emulsion → cloudy white.
keyPoints.bm: Fungsi: simpanan tenaga (dua kali tenaga karbohidrat per gram), penebat, melindungi organ. Ujian: emulsi → putih keruh.

question.en: Why do animals in cold regions have thick fat layers?
question.bm: Mengapa haiwan di kawasan sejuk mempunyai lapisan lemak yang tebal?

answer.en: Fat is a heat insulator and an energy store.
answer.bm: Lemak ialah penebat haba dan simpanan tenaga.

tip.en: Emulsion test: dissolve in ethanol FIRST, then add water.
tip.bm: Ujian emulsi: larutkan dalam etanol DAHULU, kemudian tambah air.

keyPoints.en: Nucleic acids (DNA and RNA) are made of nucleotides: phosphate + pentose sugar + nitrogenous base.
keyPoints.bm: Asid nukleik (DNA dan RNA) terdiri daripada nukleotida: fosfat + gula pentosa + bes bernitrogen.

keyPoints.en: DNA: double helix, deoxyribose sugar, bases A, T, C, G; A pairs with T, C pairs with G.
keyPoints.bm: DNA: heliks ganda dua, gula deoksiribosa, bes A, T, C, G; A berpasangan dengan T, C dengan G.

keyPoints.en: RNA: single strand, ribose sugar, uracil (U) instead of thymine.
keyPoints.bm: RNA: satu bebenang, gula ribosa, urasil (U) menggantikan timina.

keyPoints.en: DNA is coiled around proteins (histones) to form chromosomes in the nucleus. A gene is a section of DNA coding for a protein.
keyPoints.bm: DNA berlingkar pada protein (histon) membentuk kromosom dalam nukleus. Gen ialah bahagian DNA yang mengekod protein.

keyPoints.en: Uses of DNA knowledge: forensic DNA profiling, paternity tests, genetic engineering.
keyPoints.bm: Kegunaan pengetahuan DNA: profil DNA forensik, ujian paterniti, kejuruteraan genetik.

question.en: One DNA strand reads A-T-C-G. Write the complementary strand.
question.bm: Satu bebenang DNA ialah A-T-C-G. Tulis bebenang pelengkapnya.

tip.en: Remember 'Apple in the Tree, Car in the Garage' for A-T and C-G.
tip.bm: Ingat 'Apple in the Tree, Car in the Garage' untuk A-T dan C-G.
